product.name: InvoiceWise
product.tagline: GST Billing, Inventory, Manufacturing, Batch Traceability & Audit ERP System
product.targetAudience: Indian manufacturers, chemical processors, cosmetic formulators, pharmaceutical distributors, and multi-variant product packagers
product.compliance: GST Rule 46 Tax Invoicing, HSN/SAC, CGST/SGST/IGST, State Code resolution

overview.summary: InvoiceWise 3.0.1 is an enterprise-grade, standalone Windows desktop ERP software. It seamlessly unifies BOM recipe formulation, vendor-specific raw material batch inventory (FIFO), non-destructive manufacturing validation, bulk liquid packaging into ready-to-sell SKU variants, Rule 46 GST tax invoices, immutable audit ledgers, batch traceability, and desktop utility panels (Notes and repositionable Calculator).
overview.runtime: Standalone Windows Desktop Application powered by Electron 28 and embedded Node.js Express server. Zero external database dependencies (100% atomic JSON persistence).

architecture.type: Single Page Application (SPA) desktop architecture with embedded local API and atomic JSON storage

layers.role: Native Windows window management, local system integration, and print pop-up routing
Reactive DOM rendering, real-time calculation engines, modal flows, and responsive desktop layout
Business logic enforcement, unit conversion, atomic file writes, and validation
ACID-compliant safe write operations via writeJSONAtomic (temporary file + rename strategy)
Unified event sequencing connecting purchases, batches, production, packaging, and invoices

isolationRules.rawMaterials: Deducted according to formula and vendor batch allocation

isolationRules.productVariants: Increased by packaged ready-to-sell bottle count
Deducted strictly by sold bottle quantity
Restored back into variant ready-to-sell inventory

rawMaterialArchitecture.reconciliationRule: Parent Raw Material Stock is mathematically synchronized with the sum of active batch remaining quantities: Parent Stock = SUM(Active Batches Remaining Quantity).

vendorAndBatchManagement.description: Each raw material stock increase registers a distinct inward batch with full supplier provenance.
vendorAndBatchManagement.fifoConsumption: Default consumption follows FIFO (First-In, First-Out) by purchase date and batch creation time. Consumed batches remain stored permanently for historical and audit traceability.

recipeAndBOM.formulaEngine: Links ingredient raw materials with required quantities, units, and vendor preferences to target output products.
recipeAndBOM.unitConversion: Built-in unit conversion supports volume (mL, L, kL), weight (mg, g, kg, t), and count (pcs, box, btl).

vendorPreference.enforcement: If an explicit vendor is chosen, manufacturing consumes strictly from batches belonging to that vendor. If stock is insufficient, production is blocked with a clear validation error without silent vendor switching.
vendorPreference.multiVendorRecipeSupport: Supports multiple ingredient lines referencing the same raw material ID with different vendor preferences in a single BOM, accurately calculating availability and deducting from each designated vendor pool.

recipeVersioning.strategy: Modifying an existing recipe generates a new incremental version (v1, v2, v3...).
recipeVersioning.immutability: Historical manufacturing batches store an immutable snapshot of the recipe version at the time of commit, ensuring past batch logs are never corrupted by recipe updates.

stage1_preview.name: Calculate & Validate Stock
stage1_preview.characteristics: Non-destructive calculation. Checks BOM requirements, converts units, evaluates batch allocations, checks shortages, and returns detailed preview table. Does not mutate stock or write audit records.

stage2_commit.name: Manufacture / Commit Batch
stage2_commit.characteristics: Atomically revalidates inventory, consumes raw material batches, updates parent stock, increases finished goods bulk stock, creates manufacturing batch log, and generates immutable audit ledger records.

manufacturingWorkflow.noQuickPurchaseRule: The manufacturing module contains zero shortcuts for quick-add or automatic stock injection. Missing inventory strictly halts production until acquired through the formal vendor purchase flow.

finishedGoods.concept: Bulk manufactured liquid pool ready for packaging.
finishedGoods.tracking: Tracks bulk stock in primary output units, linked to manufacturing batch ID and finished goods batch ID (FGB-YYYYMMDD-NNNNN).

packaging.concept: Conversion of Finished Goods bulk stock into packaged bottle variants.
packaging.formula: Finished Goods Bulk Volume -= (Bottles Packaged * Bottle Size in mL). Variant Ready-to-Sell Stock += Bottles Packaged.
packaging.calculator: Real-time maximum feasible stock calculator prevents over-allocation.

salesAndInvoicing.taxCalculation: Intra-state (CGST + SGST) vs Inter-state (IGST) determined automatically from company state code and customer state code.
salesAndInvoicing.inventoryDeduction: Deducts strictly from ready-to-sell variant stock.

traceability.forwardTrace: Raw Material Batch -> Manufacturing Batch -> Finished Goods Batch -> SKU Variant -> Sales Invoice
traceability.backwardTrace: Sales Invoice -> SKU Variant -> Finished Goods Batch -> Manufacturing Batch -> Raw Material Batches -> Supplier Batches

auditLedger.structure: Single Unified Audit Ledger with category filters: All, Raw Material, Manufacturing, Finished Goods, Sales.
auditLedger.persistence: Permanent and immutable records saved across raw_material_transactions.json, manufacturing_audit.json, and finished_goods_transactions.json.

exports.excel: Download Audit Ledger Excel (Multi-tab workbook powered by ExcelJS including Audit Summary, RM Ledger, Manufacturing Ledger, Finished Goods Ledger, Sales Ledger, and Batch Traceability).
exports.pdf: Download Audit Ledger PDF (Landscape A4 layout with active filter reflection, correlation IDs, and company header).
exports.json: Full ERP database export bundle with metadata and version tag 3.0.1.

features: Keyboard input support (Numpad, Enter, Backspace, Escape)
Vertically draggable panel with position saved across sessions
Zero interference with ERP form inputs

backupRestore.manualBackup: Download complete timestamped JSON bundle via Settings -> Export
backupRestore.safetyBackup: Automatic pre-import backup created at data/pre_import_backup.json prior to applying changes
backupRestore.restore: Drag-and-drop or select backup JSON bundle to restore database

jsonImportExport.validation: Validates application name, JSON structure, collections, and references before executing
jsonImportExport.modularImport: Supports modular section imports (Raw Materials, Recipes, Products, Customers)

permissions.model: Role-aware administrative and operational access control
permissions.integrity: Backend enforcement of inventory invariants regardless of frontend DOM state

rules: Raw materials and recipes require non-empty names
GSTIN validated against official Indian tax format (15 characters alphanumeric)
Dates validated to ensure end dates are not earlier than start dates
Double-click submission guards on all critical modal actions

uiLayout.designSystem: Dark-mode glassmorphism interface with CSS custom properties
uiLayout.responsive: Adaptive layout supporting full screen, maximized, split screen, and narrow desktop windows
uiLayout.utilityFABs: Right-side stacked floating action buttons for Calculator and Notes

installation.prerequisites: None. Standalone Windows executable bundles all required runtimes.
installation.execution: Run InvoiceWise Setup 3.0.1.exe to install or run the portable EXE directly.
